content.value: .Two wind turbine emitting 104 dB(A) at the source are located 200 m and 240 m away from the residential point, respectively. Calculate the combined acoustic effect of these turbines at the residence.
Assume a sound absorption coefficient of 0.005 dB(A)/m and neglect the effect of ambient noise.
